name: Protoclone
summary: A full-body anthropomorphic android from Clone Robotics built on an artificial musculoskeletal system: a polymer skeleton with cast ligaments moved by roughly 1,000 water-hydraulic 'Myofiber' artificial muscles, wrapped in a sensor mesh. The 2025 Protoclone is suspended from a rig and cannot yet stand on its own, but it is one of the most complete biomimetic humanoid bodies attempted.
notable: ~1,000 water-hydraulic artificial muscles over a synthetic skeleton
Extreme biomimicry: cast bones, ligaments and vascular cooling
